resources.string: When configured, Tempo reports limited health and usage events with a random installation ID. Turn it off in Settings → Your Data.
You can change this any time in Settings → Your Data.
Share limited health and usage events with a random installation ID.
Changes the ID used for future events. This does not delete events already received by the reporting service.
What Tempo sends, and how it is running on this device
Review reporting settings and local diagnostics. Enabled online features can transmit data.
Health events use a random installation ID and include timestamps, app/OS version and locale. Crash events also include device model. Track names, raw notifications and credentials are excluded.
Configured reporting starts after the notice is shown when enabled. Turn it off in Settings → Your Data. Unconfigured builds do not report.
